summary: Two providers quote a merchant for card acceptance. One is twenty basis points cheaper on the headli...
content: Comparing domestic processing rates often provides little useful information for cross-border merchants. When multiple providers quote a merchant for card acceptance, a lower headline rate from one provider may be misleading. Merchants need to look beyond headline figures to understand the true costs associated with cross-border payments and international transactions.
